command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $script=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'display_scale_probe.py'; @'

import ctypes as c, os, subprocess, time
from ctypes import wintypes as w
from pywinauto import Desktop
import psutil

user32=c.windll.user32
shcore=c.windll.shcore
try:
    dpi=user32.GetDpiForSystem()
except Exception:
    dpi=0
print("GET_DPI_FOR_SYSTEM",dpi,flush=True)
try:
    DEVICE_PRIMARY=0
    sf=c.c_int()
    hr=shcore.GetScaleFactorForDevice(DEVICE_PRIMARY,c.byref(sf))
    print("GET_SCALE_FACTOR_FOR_DEVICE_HR",hex(hr & 0xffffffff),"VALUE",sf.value,flush=True)
except Exception as e:
    print("GET_SCALE_FACTOR_FOR_DEVICE_ERROR",repr(e),flush=True)

# Open Settings -> Display without changing anything.
os.startfile("ms-settings:display")
deadline=time.monotonic()+20
spec=None
while time.monotonic()<deadline:
    wins=[]
    for x in Desktop(backend="uia").windows(control_type="Window"):
        try:
            name=psutil.Process(x.element_info.process_id).name().lower()
            if name=="systemsettings.exe":
                wins.append(x)
        except Exception:
            pass
    if wins:
        spec=Desktop(backend="uia").window(handle=wins[0].handle)
        break
    time.sleep(.3)
if spec is None:
    raise RuntimeError("SystemSettings.exe window not found")
wrap=spec.wrapper_object()
print("SETTINGS_TITLE",repr(wrap.window_text()),flush=True)
time.sleep(2)
nodes=wrap.descendants()
print("SETTINGS_NODE_COUNT",len(nodes),flush=True)
for x in nodes:
    try:
        ct=x.element_info.control_type
        name=(x.element_info.name or x.window_text() or "").strip()
        aid=x.element_info.automation_id or ""
        if ct in ("ComboBox","Button","Text","ListItem","Slider") and (
            ct=="ComboBox" or
            any(k in name.lower() for k in ("scale","배율","display","디스플레이","100%","125%","150%","175%","200%"))
        ):
            print("SETTINGS_NODE",ct,repr(aid),repr(name),flush=True)
    except Exception: pass
try:
    wrap.close()
except Exception:
    pass

'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $script -Encoding utf8; python -X utf8 $script; $rc=$LASTEXITCODE; Remove-Item $script -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $rc
